name: Kitchen Assistance
label: Quest
description: Kitchen Assistance: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That recipe sure will come in handy. I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today. I could use a hand in making some, I'll make it worth your while.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How are those dumplings coming along?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! You're a life saver. These dumplings turned out to be quite good. Didn't really expect such good taste from the Twilight's Hammer.
